name: Neeraj Paper Marketing Limited
about: Neeraj Paper Marketing Limited engages in the marketing and trading of paper products in India. It trades in various types of paper, such as kraft linear and fluting media, duplex boards, wastepaper, M.G. tissue and poster paper, writing and printing paper, as well as maize starch. The company also trades in iron and steel, and chemicals products. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in New Delhi, India.
